articles.title: Zimbabwe mourns Chivayo, a businessman killed in helicopter crash
articles.description: Forensic experts are working to identify bodies from a helicopter crash that killed Zimbabwean businessman Wicknell Chivayo, his wife, and others. Investigators are examining the cause of the crash. A family spokesperson said the bodies are too damaged to identify. Chivayo was close to Zimbabwe's President Emmerson Mnangagwa and other African leaders. The Civil Aviation Authority of Zimbabwe said the helicopter hit the ground, spilling fuel that ignited. Chivayo was known for his wealth, lavish gifts, and connections with African leaders. His death has sparked mixed reactions, with some celebrating due to controversies surrounding his business dealings.
